resolving_diagnostics_for_unknowns.unknown: U1 readout-refinement co-adaptation: cannot separate 'readout is fine' from 'readout and refinement are co-adapted' with frozen weights (stage_a_diagnostics/README.md D2b).
resolving_diagnostics_for_unknowns.would_resolve: Controlled retraining: P2A recipe, freeze cost volume, retrain ONLY the refinement from dense alternative inits (soft-argmin vs sharpened-softmax vs top-k-detached); or retrain full model with an auxiliary GT-candidate loss. If a jointly-retrained alternative readout beats the method mean, co-adaptation is confirmed and readout becomes actionable.

resolving_diagnostics_for_unknowns.unknown: U2 true group-wise correlation (G preserved as channels into aggregation) was never tested: D3 rep D was group-averaged and G-invariant by construction (matching_diagnostic.json).
resolving_diagnostics_for_unknowns.would_resolve: Retrain P2A variant replacing the 32-ch signed-difference volume with group-wise correlation (G=8, G preserved into aggregation), identical recipe/seeds. Screening: 40 epochs x 2 seeds vs method mean 1.4409826, threshold >=0.03 px, GT<64 must not regress.
